verdict.rationale: Expensify docs mention 'Smart Limits on cards' (docs-10) and rule-based approvals (docs-3/4), suggesting some spend-control enforcement, but there is no evidence of explicit budget allocation to teams/projects or hierarchical budget enforcement tied to approvals. Missing for 10: documentation of team/project-level budget allocation, evidence that approvals block over-budget spend, and independent verification that Smart Limits reliably enforce set thresholds.
